goal: Independently QA the WP-034 Phase 4B local playable Godot slice for scope compliance, deterministic verification, gameplay readability, UI/reset behavior, camera framing, imported asset validity, and readiness for BK/Human Creative Owner play/feel review.
forbidden_changes: final BK/Human Creative Owner play-feel approval

verify.name: Godot import cache can be regenerated
Headless scene runtime output is clean
verify.command: bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

verify.name: Approved existing asset references are present

acceptance_criteria: QA does not modify implementation files under review.
QA checks WP-034 implementation against the Phase 4B brief and owner-approved constraints.
QA validates smoke/runtime output after Godot import-cache regeneration and records whether generated game/.godot cache remains non-evidence.
QA confirms the two-section flow, hazard fail, placeholder collectible/progression gate, goal, UI, retry, and camera framing are represented in the scene/script.
QA confirms imported Phase 3E asset references are prototype-only and do not imply final art approval.
QA identifies actionable rework issues if deterministic checks, scope, or playability-readiness fail.
QA recommendation does not replace BK/Human Creative Owner direct play/feel approval.
notes: This Work Package is the independent QA handoff for the WP-034 implementation slice. It may recommend pass, rework, or blocked, but it cannot approve final play/feel or edit implementation files.
